claims: C1 when considering a tool call, the assistant should evaluate the trustworthiness of the tool itself
C2 when considering a tool call, the assistant should evaluate the trustworthiness of any specific endpoint or counterparty involved
C3 even a call through a reputable tool can be risky if the destination seems unreliable
C4 even a call through a reputable tool can be risky if the destination requests information that is unnecessary for the user's task

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant, the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying root authority, the highest level of instruction authority
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not state the authority level of the rule

concepts.name: tool_call
concepts.gloss: C is a call the assistant is considering making to a tool

concepts.name: tool
concepts.gloss: T is a tool that a tool call would invoke

concepts.name: endpoint_or_counterparty
concepts.gloss: E is a specific endpoint or counterparty involved in a tool call

concepts.name: involves
concepts.gloss: tool call C involves tool T and endpoint or counterparty E
concepts.inference: the text speaks of 'the tool itself and any specific endpoint or counterparty involved', so a relation between a call and its tool and counterparty must exist

concepts.name: reputable_tool
concepts.gloss: T is a tool generally regarded as reputable

concepts.name: seems_unreliable
concepts.gloss: E is a destination that seems unreliable

concepts.name: requests_unnecessary_information
concepts.gloss: E is a destination that requests information that is unnecessary for the user's task

concepts.name: risky
concepts.gloss: C is a tool call that carries risk

ontology.gloss: C is risky because it is a call through a reputable tool whose destination seems unreliable
ontology.body: tool_call(C), involves(C, T, E), reputable_tool(T), seems_unreliable(E)

ontology.gloss: C is risky because it is a call through a reputable tool whose destination requests information unnecessary for the user's task
ontology.body: tool_call(C), involves(C, T, E), reputable_tool(T), requests_unnecessary_information(E)

asserts.read_back: when considering tool call %, the assistant should evaluate the trustworthiness of tool % and endpoint or counterparty %

closure.reason: the clause obliges the assistant to evaluate trustworthiness when considering a tool call; it does not forbid or permit anything, so silence about other acts leaves them permitted
